info: El backend autentica y aplica reglas. Este flujo solo interpreta mensajes. No tiene herramientas de escritura ni credenciales de pacientes.

name: Validar y construir esquema
Validar JSON
func:
try{if(msg.statusCode!==200)throw new Error();const result=JSON.parse(msg.payload.message.content);if('act' in result){if(!Object.hasOwn(result,'value'))result.value=null;if(!['provide','refuse','abandon','explain','question','clarify','support','other'].includes(result.act)||result.value!==null&&typeof result.value!=='string'||Object.keys(result).some(k=>!['act','value','target'].includes(k)))throw new Error();msg.payload={field_understanding:result};}else{if(!["greeting","menu","change_options","list_appointments","select_appointment","availability","reserve","reschedule","cancel","payment_status","pending_payments","pending_requests","request_status","select_request","verify_payment","assign_doctor","approve_change","reject_change","complete","knowledge","confirm","deny","support","unknown"].includes(result.intent))throw new Error();for(const k of ['appointment_code','doctor_name','date','time','reason','request_id']){if(!Object.hasOwn(result,k))result[k]=null;if(result[k]!==null&&typeof result[k]!=='string')throw new Error();}msg.payload=result;}msg.statusCode=200;}catch{msg.statusCode=502;msg.payload={error:'No fue posible interpretar la solicitud.'};}
  msg.headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'};return msg;
